newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close up on CANTV optimism.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close up on CANTV optimism.

text.p: Caracas stocks firmed as investors bought on optimism over the continuing placement of the government's 49 percent share in telephone company CANTV, traders said.
In addition, as investors sold stocks to raise cash to buy CANTV shares, "some shares were left undervalued, which were snapped-up, so helping the market," said Merinvest analyst Roberto Isasi.
The bolsa's index gained 2.1 percent to end at 5,961.38 points as 20 stocks rose, 13 fell and six closed flat.
Traders added the market was poised to rally after the CANTV placement, which could boost the bourse's market capitalization by as much as 10 percent from its current level of $7.28 billion.

Among widely-held shares, Electricidad de Caracas rose 17.00 bolivars to 540.00; Ceramica Carabobo Series II shares rose 5.00 bolivars to end at 490.00, while its Series I shares fell 10.00 bolivars to 500.00; and steel-producer Sivensa fell 4.00 bolivars to end at 324.00 bolivars.
